column3: 疲れ始めフラフラと進むエール達
column4: El and the others begin to tire and stagger forward.

column3: その目の前に魔人レイが立ち塞がる
column4: Fiend Lei appears blocking their path right before them.

column3: 悪いがここは通せない・・
column4: Sorry, but I can't let you pass here...

column3: 戦いが始まって30分、勝負が付かない疲れだけが溜まっていく
column4: The battle has lasted 30 minutes without a clear winner; only fatigue accumulates.

column3: 距離を取り、こちらを殺さない程度にレイは戦う、時間だけかかる
column4: Lei keeps distance and fights without killing them, prolonging the time.

column3: どういうつもりだと聞くと、魔王様の子供達を殺す訳にはいかんしな、諦めて帰って
column4: When asked his intention, he says he can't kill the Demon King's children and hopes they will give up and return.

column3: くれるのを期待しているのだけどねと余裕のある言い方をする
column4: He speaks confidently, expecting them to give up.

column3: エール達、子供達もイライラ、仲間同士で口喧嘩しはじめる、心が折れかかる。
column4: El and the children grow irritated and start quarrelling among themselves, their spirits nearly breaking.

column3: それを見たアームズが子供達を先にいかせ、魔剣カオスを持って魔人レイに立ち塞がる
column4: Arms sees this, lets the children go ahead, and stands in front of Fiend Lei wielding the Demon Sword Chaos.

column3: 私はランスの子ではないよ、どうだい、本気で相手する気になったかいとレイを挑発
column4: I'm not Rance's child, you know. So, how about it? Are you ready to take me seriously? Lei was provoked.

column3: 面白い女だとレイもその挑発に乗る
column4: Lei found her an interesting woman and took the bait.

column3: ※カオスか日光か、エールの持って居るのを１本借り受けます
column4: * Whether Chaos or Nikkou, we'll borrow one of the ones El has.
